model.title: Improving Access to Workers’ Compensation for Injured Federal Workers Act of 2025
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. Susan Collins (R-ME)

summary.text: The bill would expand federal workers' compensation coverage to include medical services provided by physician assistants and nurse practitioners, currently limited to doctors and other specified healthcare providers. This aims to improve access to care for injured federal employees by broadening the types of qualified medical professionals who can treat them under the federal workers' compensation program.
